content: Pointwise OLS at grid column j: design matrix X_j is n×(1+p) where column 0 is all-ones (intercept), columns 1..p are [pred_k[i,j]] across observations i. Solve X_j'X_j coef = X_j'y_j by normal equations. X_j'X_j is (p+1)×(p+1) — small, so Gaussian elimination is sufficient (no need for nalgebra SVD). Result: coef[0]=intercept at j, coef[1..p]=predictor betas at j. Multicollinearity risk when predictors are highly correlated at that column — Tikhonov ridge eps*I stabilizes the small system.
